title: GatewayHeartbeatResponse
description: The E2 200 body, contract 1 and 2 (docs/design/discovery-contract.md section 2.4). The control plane adds discovery_leases, snapshot_generations and bound_targets_version (and bound_targets when they changed) only when it answers contract_version 2, which it does only when the request listed 2. A contract 1 Gateway decodes this body leniently and ignores the extra fields. It carries ids, generations and times only.

discovery_leases.description: Leases granted to this replica by this response, at most one per connector. A lease is never repeated in a later response; the replica keeps it until expires_at or until it uploads.

snapshot_generations.description: The latest accepted discovery generation per connector that has a stored snapshot. A replica whose highest opened generation is lower fetches the snapshot (E9).

bound_targets.description: Sent only when bound_targets_version differs from the one in the request. Full replace: every Argo CD target, static or discovered, that has at least one binding that is not deleted, suspended or not. At most 4096 target ids across all connectors.

generation.description: Strictly greater than every generation granted before for this connector. Gaps are allowed (an expired lease burns its generation).

expires_at.description: Control-plane clock. The lease holder must finish its upload before expires_at minus 15 seconds, measured with the Date header offset; otherwise it abandons the run.
